channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: strong headwind (−3.2).

item.title: [−1] Brent settles 0.8% lower at $115.81 as Qatar, Saudi, Turkey and Pakistan hold talks in Tehran
item.description:
Peace hopes trimmed prices, though Iran's Guard declared the strait closed and attacks on Saudi Arabia continued. Still near six-month highs after $117.38 on Friday. Easing slightly.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Retailer losses persist

Why it matters: Mediation offers a path to lower oil, but crude near $116 still keeps India's import bill, fuel costs and inflation high.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [−1] High tanker rates make Russian oil unviable for a state refiner in November; Gulf discounts lure buyers
item.description:
Record freight wipes out the Russian discount, so Indian refiners are turning to discounted Gulf cargoes where available. Escalating shift.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Costlier crude mix

Why it matters: Losing cheap Russian barrels raises India's average crude cost and leans more on Gulf supply exposed to Hormuz risk.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] October sets a record of 28 attacks on Hormuz shipping; Iran says 'illegal routes' will soon be blocked
item.description:
Another tanker was disabled in the strait. Iran's oil keeps flowing while Gulf neighbours' exports are shut. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Gulf supply risk

Why it matters: Rising attacks and new route threats keep insurance, freight and delivered crude and LNG costs at records for India.

Market gauges: Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Saudi–Houthi de-escalation ends; Saudi Arabia plans an assault to break the Red Sea chokehold
item.description:
The two sides exchanged attacks in the Gulf and Red Sea, and Red Sea war-risk insurance is rising. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Saudi supply risk

Why it matters: A wider war threatens Saudi crude bound for India and the Red Sea route for Indian exports to Europe, adding to freight costs.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1, Growth outlook −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] US president says it is 'decision time' on Iran: a deal or strikes to 'finish it off'
item.description:
Iran wants seven conditions met before talks and says it is preparing a response to any strike. Reports say the US military could launch a major operation within 96 hours if ordered. Escalation risk.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Supply shock risk

Why it matters: A strike would likely push oil sharply higher and hit Indian equities, the rupee and bonds; a deal would bring the biggest relief.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: low · horizon: days
